title: Upload review
idea: Upload review: A visible intake region becomes a per-file review queue with source, validation and processing status.
audience: People who need to review upload within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: Files require correction or validation before submission.
avoidWhen: A single opaque spinner would hide partial failure.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic process layout through its review upload priority and explicit commitment contract: Accepted files remain distinguishable from uploading, rejected and unprocessed files.
navigation: Upload review keeps the current review upload context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A visible intake region becomes a per-file review queue with source, validation and processing status.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to review upload; files require correction or validation before submission.
composition.priority: Accepted files remain distinguishable from uploading, rejected and unprocessed files.

imagery.role: Support the actual review upload context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use per-file rows and explicit add-file actions instead of relying on drop gestures.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the upload review structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no review upload content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Accepted files remain distinguishable from uploading, rejected and unprocessed files.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized review upload content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Accepted files remain distinguishable from uploading, rejected and unprocessed files.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active review upload context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
